data.raw_text:
Pansamantalang ginamit ng mga mag-aaral sa San Francisco High School sa Quezon City ang kanilang covered court bilang classroom sa unang araw ng pasukan.

Ito ay matapos masunog ang 20 silid-aralan ng naturang paaralan nitong Linggo.

data.english_translation: Students at the San Francisco High School in Quezon City have temporarily used their wandering court as classroom on the first day of the school. This is after 20 school classrooms have burned down this Sunday.
